name: Lua 5.1 reference manual
purpose: Language reference for legacy Lua syntax used by WoW addon hosts. Lua is MIT; this is documentation, not an installed runtime. Modern Forever host APIs are separate from the language version.

name: Lupa
purpose: Python wrapper for Lua/LuaJIT. Development-only Lua 5.1 execution for addon behavior tests. Lupa 2.8 Windows x64 CPython 3.12 wheel and lua51 runtime exercised locally; MIT-style wrapper license; retain component notices if redistributing. Host mocks do not reproduce WoW taint or secret values.

name: WoW UI source mirror
purpose: Third-party mirror of Blizzard UI and generated API documentation. Forever branch inspected at ca8368f2f2380cbe696854f7f2646387c278a61b. Useful for modern namespaced APIs despite interface 16001; Blizzard material retains its terms, not a permissive code dependency or guaranteed exact local-build match.

name: Tweaks Forever
purpose: Active Forever QoL addon reference for optional modules and conflicts. Author README and installed v0.15.2 metadata inspected; GPL-3.0-or-later with separately attributed data and libraries. Verify exact source, assets and current client support before any port or reuse.
